servinfo.title: Front Seat Belt Pretensioner Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Seat Belt Pretensioner Removal and Installation

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when checking the seat belt pretensioner can result in personal injury due to accidental activate of the seat belt pretensioner.
Never measure the resistance of the seat belt pretensioner.

servinfo.ptxt: Check seat belt assembly (retractor pretensioner) and if any of the following conditions is found, replace seat belt assembly (retractor pretensioner) with new one.

attention3.ptxt: As retractor pretensioners are controlled with driver and passenger air bags, you should judge that pretensioners have been activated if air bags have deployed.

item.ptxt: Retractor pretensioner is damaged or a strong impact was applied to it.
